main: Use case: logo-brand. Create a single finished mascot logo for vikunja-x based on the character in the two provided reference images. Image 1 is the PRIMARY reference: preserve her adorable slightly bashful winking expression, pale sage/lime green hair, dark charcoal horns with restrained gold accents, pointed ears, dark central hair streak, blue open eye, black side ribbons, tiny blush and affection. Image 2 is ONLY supporting reference for the same character's hair color and horn identity. Make a clean compact chibi head-and-tiny-hands logo: oversized rounded head, short simplified side hair masses, two compact dark horn shapes, one open blue eye and one wink, a tiny soft smile, two tiny blue-gloved hands holding a small coral-red heart directly below her chin. Reduce all details to bold smooth shapes with consistent deep charcoal outlines, mostly flat colors, only one subtle cel-shade per hair mass, polished elegant 2D anime sticker icon, not glossy 3D. Keep head very dominant so reads at 32px. Horns fully within frame. Approx 88% canvas occupancy, centered square composition, generous transparent margin, truly transparent background. No lettering, no wordmark, no logos from references, no surrounding hearts, no scenery, no gradients, no detached particles, no white sticker border, no multiple alternatives, no watermark. This is a new simplified drawing of the referenced character, not a crop of the input.
small: Use case: logo-brand. Edit the supplied mascot artwork into an EXTREMELY SIMPLE tiny app logo. Preserve character identity: pale sage green hair, two dark compact horns with a single gold inset each, a dark central fringe streak, one blue open eye and one wink, pink cheeks, one tiny coral heart under chin. This is a small icon companion to the detailed reference, not an illustration. Draw only approximately 15-20 large flat shapes. Remove hands, all clothing, jewelry, forehead ornament, all hair strand lines, ribbon folds, eyeshine complexity, texture, gradients and shadows. A rounded almost circular chibi head with two very short pointy horns, two small side hair lobes and tiny pointed ears; one large blue oval eye with one white dot, a thick curved wink, tiny smile. Short bob-like pale sage hair silhouette and ONE broad charcoal fringe streak retain recognisability. A small coral heart immediately touching the chin. Bold very smooth charcoal outline about 3% of total width, uniform. Flat creamy sage, charcoal, pale peach, cornflower blue, muted gold and coral. Head fills 85% of square, enough clear transparent edge padding. Must read as a simple cute face at 16 and 32 pixels. Transparent background, no text, no wordmarks, no surrounding decorations, no white sticker border. One single compact icon only.
